title: FlexAvatar: High-Fidelity 3D Head Avatars via Bias Sinks
summary: FlexAvatar is a state-of-the-art framework that generates animatable 3D head avatars from sparse inputs like a single photograph. It utilizes 3D Gaussian Splatting and a novel Bias Sinks mechanism to enable training on diverse monocular and multi-view datasets.
research_notes: Developed by the Technical University of Munich (TUM); represents a significant shift toward Large Reconstruction Models (LRMs) for head avatars.

evolution.summary: As a successor to GaussianAvatars, it introduces Bias Sinks to prevent identity-pose entanglement when training on monocular video. The research paper was released in late 2025, with the official code repository currently awaiting full source code publication.
